name: ASOCA (Automated Segmentation Of Coronary Arteries, MICCAI 2020) - training set via UK Data Service ReShare 855916
format: NRRD (per the zip contents listed by the Kaggle mirror: Diseased/Annotations/*.nrrd); UKDS zips are 2 GB each
labels: Voxel-wise coronary lumen segmentation (majority vote of 3 experts), centrelines, calcium scores, lumen meshes
license: UK Data Service End User Licence (files). Documentation is CC BY-SA 4.0. Redistribution is not allowed. Commercial use and sharing derived labels must be checked with the DAC ([contact removed]).
steps_to_access: 1) The project lead registers with the UK Data Service (https://beta.ukdataservice.ac.uk/myaccount). 2) Email [contact removed] (ASOCA DAC) with the project purpose and request permission for SN 855916. The UNSW record says evidence of ethics approval or a waiver may be required. 3) After the owner approves, contact the UKDS Access Helpdesk to release ASOCA_Normal.zip and ASOCA_Diseased.zip. Fallback: the temporary MS Form linked from https://asoca.grand-challenge.org/ (https://forms.office.com/r/HK38BahFiM). Expected wait: days to weeks (not stated).
provenance: Coronary Atlas project, Auckland City Hospital (NZ), 2017-2020. The same 20 diseased cases are also listed as Zenodo 4531428 (restricted) and UNSWorks doi:10.26190/ntyk-bm92 (metadata only). The 20 normal cases have a matching UNSWorks record. Independent of ImageCAS.
verified: Read the UKDS page (2 x 2 GB zips, closed access, UKDS EUL), the grand-challenge home and access pages, Zenodo API record 4531428 (restricted, no files) and UNSWorks DSpace metadata. Nothing downloaded (gated).
notes: Highest-value T1 source in this territory. The 20-case ASOCA test set (10 normal, 10 diseased) is not in the UKDS deposit; the paper says the test images were released without ground truth. Ask the DAC for those images too. Two unofficial Kaggle mirrors exist (kaggle.com/datasets/ayuuushsri/asoca-dataset, 'Apache 2.0'; kaggle.com/datasets/ayushsri2004/asoca-data; both 4.12 GB, same file list). They appear to be unauthorised redistributions of a UKDS-EUL dataset. Do NOT use them for shared annotations; use the official route.

name: ImageCHD (MICCAI 2020) - congenital heart disease CT

n_scans.unit: patients (1 cardiac CTA each), mostly children

labels: 7 heart and great-vessel classes (LV, RV, LA, RA, Myo, AO, PA). Per-case CHD diagnosis xlsx (16 types). Image-info xlsx with birth date, acquisition date, pixel spacing (~0.24-0.42 mm), z 0.75 mm, scanner.
license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Kaggle). Non-commercial only. Derivative labels are allowed with attribution, and must stay NC.
steps_to_access: No login needed (tested 2026-10-12): the Kaggle API download endpoint works anonymously and redirects to a signed GCS URL. Per file: curl -L -o <name> 'https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/imagechd/<name>' for each of ImageCHD_dataset.change2zip, ImageCHD_dataset.z01..z12. Some files come back wrapped in a one-entry zip; if `unzip -l` shows only the same filename inside, unwrap it first. Rename *.change2zip to *.zip and extract the multi-part archive with `7z x <name>.zip` (all .z01..zNN parts in the same folder). Whole dataset in one go: curl -L -o imagechd.zip 'https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/imagechd'. Kaggle's terms still apply; the lead may prefer to accept them with a free Kaggle account.
provenance: Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital, Siemens SOMATOM Definition Flash, 2017-2018. CHD68 (MICCAI 2019) is very likely a subset of it. NIfTI headers have pixdim=1,1,1, so the true voxel spacing is not stored. Intensities are stored without rescale and look like HU+1024 (soft-tissue peak ~900-1100, contrast lumen ~1300-1600). Convert with HU = value - 1024 and verify per scan. Same group and hospital as ImageCAS (Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital), but a different disease cohort: no patient-level overlap is known, but it cannot be ruled out.
verified: Downloaded the final split part (129 MB). Parsed the zip64 central directory: 223 entries = 110 images + 110 labels + 2 xlsx. Extracted ct_1178_image.nii.gz: 512x512x315 int16, histogram peak 900-1000 (soft tissue) with a tail to 1500+ (contrast ~+300-500 HU). Read both xlsx (SOMATOM Definition Flash, 0.75 mm). All files deleted.
notes: Paediatric CHD hearts with small coronaries. Some cases (e.g. CA = coronary anomaly column) are relevant. Spacing must be restored from the xlsx.

name: HOCMvalvesSeg (MIDL 2024, PMLR v222) - hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy cardiac CT
labels: AV, MV, AO, LA, LV, myocardium, excised myocardium
steps_to_access: curl -L -o 10_image.nii 'https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/hocmvalvesseg/10_image.nii' (repeat per file; 54 files; list via https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/list/xiaoweixumedicalai/hocmvalvesseg, paginated).
provenance: Same Guangdong group, SOMATOM Definition Flash, 0.25x0.25x0.5 mm (stated).
verified: Downloaded 10_image.nii (133 MB, served raw). 512x512x509, but the values are uint8-like 0-255 (intensity-windowed) with pixdim 1,1,1, so it is not HU. About 4% of voxels are saturated at 255 (bright contrast blood pool). Deleted.
notes: Lossy 8-bit windowed export (no HU, no spacing), so lower value for model inference. Probably ECG-gated surgical-planning CTA with coronaries in the FOV (not verified visually).

name: TCIA - gated contrast cardiac CTA series found inside oncology collections

n_scans.unit: patients: VAREPOP-APOLLO AP-26JK (TAVR protocol 'CARDIAC CTA', BestDiast/BestSyst), NSCLC Radiogenomics AMC-015 (GATED_CHEST_CTA), AMC-027 (GATED_CHEST_CTA, Isovue 370)

labels: none
provenance: Also mirrored in IDC (likely already in IDC.json).
verified: Scanned all 156 public NBIA collections (excluding NLST and 4D-Lung) with the getSeries API and regex on SeriesDescription/ProtocolName/BodyPart. Downloaded the AP-26JK series (459 x 0.6 mm, SOMATOM Definition Flash, BodyPart HEART, protocol TAVR, study 'CARDIAC CTA'): 16% of central voxels are 200-700 HU, so contrast is confirmed. Sampled 10 slices each of AMC-015/AMC-027 (study 'CT ANGIO THORAX' / 'GATED_CHEST_CTA'; contrast 'APPLIED' / 'Isovue 370'; p99 ~510 HU). All deleted.
notes: TCIA has no cardiac/coronary collection: the browse table (230 collections) has no Heart location, and 'Limited' collections are mostly H&N/brain. Other cardiac-named series are non-contrast or PET-AC (VAREPOP-APOLLO AP-2BGM 'AC FB Rest/Stress Cardiac', RIDER Lung PET-CT 'Calcium Score CT' / 'RG CARDIAC ECG MOD'), so excluded. T3 chest CTA/CTPA series exist in small numbers (COVID-19-NY-SBU ~31 pts 'CTA', CMB-LCA ~13 pts, CMB-BRCA, CPTAC-LUAD/PDA, MIDRC-RICORD-1A/1B, TCGA-UCEC). New 2026 'Healthy-Total-Body-CTs' is low-dose non-contrast, so excluded.
